faqs.q: How can I earn reward points with the Klick Credit Card?
faqs.a: You earn 2 reward points for every Rs. 200 spent on non-UPI transactions. This makes it ideal for offline shopping and daily expenses.

faqs.q: What travel benefits does the Klick Credit Card offer?
faqs.a: The card charges a low forex markup fee of 2.75%, making it cost-effective for international transactions. Additionally, it provides convenience and rewards for overseas travel and online shopping.

faqs.q: Is there a fuel surcharge waiver on this credit card?
faqs.a: Yes. You get a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel purchases across stations, capped at Rs. 250 per month.

faqs.q: What cashback benefits are offered on UPI and online payments?
faqs.a: Paying with the Klick Credit Card on Kiwi gives 1.5% cashback on UPI Scan & Pay transactions and 0.5% cashback on online payments, maximizing savings on digital transactions.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the Klick Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can apply by completing the KYC process via the Kiwi app. The card is entirely virtual, making it easy to access rewards and benefits without visiting a branch.

faqs.question: Is the Kiwi RuPay Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: The Yes Bank and AU Bank variants have no joining or annual fee. Kiwi Neon is an optional membership at ₹999 + taxes a year. Check the fee on the Kiwi app for the PNB card.

faqs.question: How much cashback does the Kiwi card give without Neon?
faqs.answer: The base card gives 1.5% on UPI Scan & Pay, which is 6 Kiwis per ₹100. Online non-UPI spends earn 0.5%.

faqs.question: What is the value of 1 Kiwi?
faqs.answer: 1 Kiwi is worth ₹0.25. You need 500 Kiwis (₹125) to redeem, in multiples of 500. At the top Neon tier of 5%, you earn 20 Kiwis per ₹100.

faqs.question: Is Kiwi Neon worth ₹999?
faqs.answer: Neon costs about ₹1,179 with taxes. It pays for itself at the ₹50,000 annual UPI spend milestone, where 3% cashback gives ₹1,500. Below that it loses money.

faqs.question: How many lounge visits do I get with the Kiwi card?
faqs.answer: Standard cardholders get no lounge access. Neon members get 1 domestic lounge visit at each annual UPI spend milestone of ₹50,000, ₹1 lakh and ₹1.5 lakh, up to 3 a year.
